configurations_unchanged.basis: parts 6-8 found no justified change to either configuration (REPORT6.txt, REPORT7.txt, REPORT8.txt); both run exactly as on SR-VP (REPORT_frozen2.txt)
configurations_unchanged.PRIMARY: embedding-list bond tree, fixed distance: z >= 10.6 lists (one best match per genome, own genome group excluded) from the exact GPU z table (Z_STORE 10.5); genome groups by the emb_hom 0.75 average-linkage rule; vl round 0 with <= 2 intervening genes, 'grp' counting, round-0 homolog exclusion masks K1000; list tau by vl's rule (ladder 4-20, round-0 instance FDR over 3 gene-order shuffles <= .01); L4b tree at theta .02 with the family-free kNN cohesion kappa_var_knn50; every node kept (L4b+). Output L4bp_t0.02
configurations_unchanged.SECONDARY: family-bond tree, adaptive distance: rescue3 family tokens; genome groups (0.75 rule); lw.py WA bonds (every token pair within 8 positions tested at its own distance); bond tau by the 1% shuffle rule (ladder 4-50, 3 within-genome token shuffles); L4b tree at theta .2 with token cohesion kappa_var_tokens; closed-form family node test at the bond tau (n >= 2, Lambda >= tau, nI >= 2). Output L4b_t0.2
configurations_unchanged.rule_for_every_data_derived_number: nothing is chosen on this set: taus, genome groups, cohesion floors (1,000,000 random cross-genome gene pairs, seed 17), exclusion masks (softrec mode 1) and the engine's rule (its coverage rule at FDR .01) come from their fixed rules; whitening = the package's stored transform, applied, never refitted; other theta outputs written by the unchanged code are never scored or reported

comparators.engine_reference: recurrence engine (engine/code/recurrence.py, unchanged) on the same rescue3 tokens: --w 3 --null genome --perms 3 --fdr .01, Louvain modules, --all-genome-loci; nested reading DH = level-2 conserved loci UNION rule-H cores (Louvain res .3, seed 17, trim f .5) via boundary blib / rules read-only; lineages = GTDB genera from the package genome table (genomes without a genus count as their own lineage, the engine's rule)
comparators.pair_linking: L1 of each base's own bonds (Z L1, WA L1)
comparators.not_run: the synton pipeline (not requested for this run)

pipeline_as_on_SR_VP.code: frozen2/code copied to frozen3/code with paths only (package path, output root $RD/long_loci/frozen3, data key 'gtdb3', engine arm name); diffs recorded in the notebook before any job. If the lut layout puts the FASTA at proteins_gid.faa, the SR-VP shadow directory is not needed; otherwise the same shadow link is used
pipeline_as_on_SR_VP.J1_tokens: MMseqs2 release 18: base cluster -s 7.5 -e 1e-3 --min-seq-id 0 -c 0.5 --cov-mode 0 --cluster-mode 0 -> mmseqs_tokens.py; rescue3: unique sequences, genes in base tokens of < 3 genes searched against all unique sequences (prefilter -s 7.5 --max-seqs 1000; align -e 1e-5 -a) -> 06b_rescue3.py; 24 CPUs, standard_expand; guard: the job stops before the rescue if its projected time passes 115 min, and the projection is reported
pipeline_as_on_SR_VP.J2_gpu_table: transfer_spacedust gtable.py copy: per unique sequence and genome, best zca10 cosine, local index, within-genome z; stored where z >= 10.5; genome-pair sums for emb_hom; one A5000 (partition gpu), fp16 vectors
pipeline_as_on_SR_VP.J3_gpu_knn: gpu_knn_sd.py copy: exact cosine kNN, k 2,000, one A5000
pipeline_as_on_SR_VP.J4_main: uid gate (package uid_of_row = 06a gid2uid), float32 zca10 (stored transform applied; gate max |f32 - stored f16| <= 1e-3), genome groups, token cohesion, SECONDARY build (lw.py WA), engine, DH; 24 CPUs
pipeline_as_on_SR_VP.J5a_list_prep: adapter smoke, kNN cohesion, exclusion masks; 40 CPUs (standard_expand_2) for memory only (SR-VP peak 90 GiB for 3.17 M uids)
pipeline_as_on_SR_VP.J5b_list_arm: z >= 10.6 lists, vl round 0 over the observed order and 3 shuffles, list tau, L1 / L4b / L4b+ at theta .02; 24 CPUs
pipeline_as_on_SR_VP.J6_scoring: ribosomal scoring and descriptive statistics (below); 24 CPUs
pipeline_as_on_SR_VP.chaining: dependent Slurm jobs (afterok; scoring afterany) that write their results to disk; login-node watchdog (frozen/code/watchdog.sh) cancels a job past about twice its expected time or stuck on a dependency that can never be met; no timeout inside job scripts; Slurm preflight (both cluster instruction files read in the same turn) before every submission
pipeline_as_on_SR_VP.projection: from SR-VP (3.21 M genes): tokens 75-100 min, GPU table 12-20 min, GPU kNN 10-15 min, main 9-15 min, list prep 5-8 min, list arm 5-8 min, scoring < 10 min: about 2-2.5 h of CPU job time in total, no single job above 2 h; GPU passes well under 1 h each. Re-projected from the package's gene count at phase 2; the coordinator is told before submission if the total passes 5 h or a job passes 2 h, or a GPU pass 1 h

outputs_for_the_audit_scorer: locus tables as on SR-VP: parquet files with columns s, e (inclusive gids of the package universe, e > s) at $RD/long_loci/frozen3/loci/gtdb3_Z/L4bp_t0.02.parquet (PRIMARY), loci/gtdb3_WA/L4b_t0.2.parquet (SECONDARY), loci/gtdb3_Z/L1.parquet, loci/gtdb3_WA/L1.parquet, loci/gtdb3_engine/DH.parquet; listed with sha256 in results/locus_tables.json

ribosomal_scoring.pass_bars: NOT set here: they are the audit agent's, frozen separately in benchmarks/redesign/ribo_audit/predeclared6.json (path now; sha256 recorded when the coordinator sends it, before any score). This run reports its standing-definition counts beside the audit table
ribosomal_scoring.runs: the package's ribosomal truth runs (g2, >= 16 marked genes) if the package provides them; otherwise runs built with ribosomal_check's run rule from the audit agent's Ribosomal_* Pfam annotation output (stated in the report). No HMM search of my own
ribosomal_scoring.standing_definition: ribosomal_check.score: best locus = largest overlap with the run (ties: shorter); recovered best_frac >= .5; resolved best_frac >= .8 and precision >= .8; plus the any-fitting-locus count (some locus with overlap / run >= .8 and overlap / locus >= .8); paired resolved differences between outputs (run bootstrap 10,000, seed 17)
ribosomal_scoring.subsets: Bacteria and Archaea separately; the parity halves if the package defines them

descriptive_statistics: per output: loci, share of genes in loci (all, Bacteria, Archaea), span quantiles; genome groups at 0.75 (count, size distribution); bond / list taus with their FDR ladders; bonds and bonded boundaries; token family counts; costs (wall time and peak memory per stage)
no_curated_criteria: the set has no curated-system truth; no curated score is computed or claimed
deviation_policy: any departure from this file is recorded in the notebook and the report as a deviation with its reason. Execution changes that cannot change an output (CPU count for memory, job split or resume from a saved stage, path layout) are allowed and recorded. No setting is changed and nothing is rerun after any score is seen; a failed job is resubmitted unchanged or reported as not run

expectations.groups: 250-500 genome groups at 0.75 (complete genomes spread over many genera; SR-VP gave 277 for 994 genomes, lut 179 for 1,032)
expectations.ribosomal_standing: recovered >= 97% for both configurations and DH. Resolved: PRIMARY 50-72%, SECONDARY 45-68%, DH 30-55%, pair-linking 25-45%; Archaea above Bacteria by 20-40 points for both configurations (SR-VP single-contig genomes: PRIMARY 52%, Archaea 95%). Any-fit 80-92% for both configurations, 15-35 points above their standing resolved count
expectations.pairwise: PRIMARY - SECONDARY resolved 0 to +60 runs; both configurations above DH by +100 to +300 runs on about 1,000 runs
